reviews.comment: Very good for micro atx motherboards and provides good airflow. No front fans but that's not really a deal breaker to me i just got some nzxt fans and they worked fine for me. 5070 fits easily
reviews.author: TysonH

reviews.title: Fantastic somewhat small case
reviews.comment: Despite the controversy surrounding their PC rental program, I really like this new case from them! It's super good looking in person and seems to have incredibly good airflow. NZXT is filling a niche here for people like me who still like Micro ATX towers over full ATX towers without it being a cheap, low quality, piece of garbage. My pervious case was one of those pieces of garbage's in question, and after swapping into the new case, the PSU fan kicks on a lot less and the GPU hotspot temperature dropped 10C!
reviews.author: ZacharyM
